user.title: Get a Mi bind key
user.description:
Pick a Xiaomi Bluetooth device ({count} found nearby), or type its MAC address. Home Assistant will connect to it and **activate** it with a new local identity, the same way TelinkFlasher's "Do Activation" button does.

⚠️ Activation replaces the device's existing keys. If the device is paired in the Mi Home app it will stop working there until you pair it again (which creates yet another key).

The device must be in range of a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy that supports active connections.
